name: @io.seqera/app-bootstrap-api
description: TypeSpec API definition for App Bootstrap

scripts._comment: TypeSpec compilation produces versioned openapi-{version}.yaml files, then bash oneliner finds highest version and saves as openapi-latest.yaml
scripts.build: tsp compile . && find ../build/openapi -name 'openapi-*.yaml' -not -name 'openapi-latest.yaml' | sort -V | tail -1 | xargs -I {} cp {} ../build/openapi/openapi-latest.yaml
